description: Door-hardware test runbook for the VFT/ZKTeco access-control campaign, in two tracks: a short PHYSICAL visit (only what needs a hand, an eye, a menu or a cable at the readers) and a REMOTE day (everything else, with both readers online at VFT), run by a lead and six agents in phases the console enforces. Canonical task definitions; live status is the Door Hardware Runbook artifact database (collection "results"). Brief: docs/architecture/access-control-hardware-session.md.

members.HW Test 5–10: remote track only — never a finger

physical.summary: One interactive session at VFT with the operator. Bands: 1 must (do-not-ship), 2 should, 3 optional; PH-30 closes every visit; PH-31 only on the last.

lead.summary: The owner's interactive session at home: preflight, member creation, the screens, spawning the agents, the soak, syncing results, the close.

outbox.summary: Parallel phase: command delivery, ordering, lost replies.

lifecycle.summary: Parallel phase: names, consent integrity, double cancellation, concurrent writes.

api.members: none (E2E gyms via the local dev server)

evidence.summary: Parallel phase: cases decided by code and tests, cited file:line.
